spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (हलति)
To plough.

n. (-लं)
A plough.
f. (-ला)
1 Vinous liquor.
2 The earth.
3 Water.
E.
हल to plough, aff. अच्.

ind.
A vocative particle, addressed in theatrical language to a female friend.
E.
हल to plough, आ aff.

BALARĀMA.
2
A name of ŚĀ

LIVĀHANA.
3

A plough.
f. (-ला)
Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor.
(-ली)
A wife's younger sister.
E.
हाल a plough, aff. अण्, or हल to plough, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Holding or having a plough.
m. (-रः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
हस्न, and धर who holds or has.

mfn. (-भृत्)
Having a plough.
m. (-भृत्)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
हल a plough, and भृत् possessing.

Agriculture.
2

A saint so named.
E.
हल a plough, and भृति having.

f. (-तिः)
Ploughing, furrowing.
E.
हल, and हति striking.

m. (-ब्दः)
Noise, tumult.
E.
हलहला imitative sound, शब्द sound.

m. (-धः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
हल a plough, आयुध a weapon.

m. (-हः)
A horse of mixed colour; also read हालाह.

m. (-हः)
A piebald horse.

mn. (-लः-लं)
A sort of poison.
m. (-लः)
1 A kind of snake.
2 A Jaina or Bauddha deified saint.
3 A sort of lizard or newt.
E.
हस्न to plough, अच् aff., अ negative, and हल the same; also हलहस्न, &c.

n. (-लं)
A sort of poison: see the next.

n. (-लं)
A sort of poison; also variously read हलाहलं, हस्नहलं, हास्नाहलं.

n. (-लं)
A sort of poison: see हास्नहाल.
f. (-स्ना)
A small mouse.
f. (-ली)
Wine, spirituous liquor.
m. (-लः)
A sort of worm or insect, a kind of newt.

m. (-लिः)
1 A furrow.
2 Agriculture.
E.
हस्न to plough, इन् aff.

BALADEVA.
2

A ploughman, a cultivator.
f. (-नी)
A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya.
E.
हस्न a plough, इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
The Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.)
f. (-या)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
हस्नि BALARĀMA, and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-नः)
The teak tree.
E.
हस्न a plough, ख aff.

n. (-कं)
A sort of jaundice.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Ploughed, tilled.
f. (-ल्या)
A multitude of ploughs.
m. (-ल्यः)
Ploughing.
E.
हस्न a plough, यत् aff.

n. (-कं)
The red lotus.
E.
ह्लाद to delight, ण्वुल् aff.; form irr.

m. (-कः)
A horse of a yellowish red, or tawny colour.

n. (-नं)
Rolling or tossing as in sleep.

n. (-षं)
1 A minor dramatic entertainment, chiefly of singing and dancing by one male and eight or ten female performers, a ballet.
2 A dance performed by women in a circle.
E.
हेला wanton sport, लष् or स्नस to be skilful, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; also हल्लीस.

n. (-सं)
A dramatic entertainment, &c.: see हल्लीष.

m. (-कं)
Dancing in a ring as performed by women.
E.
कन् added to हल्लीस or हल्लीष, whence it is also read हल्लीसक.

m. (-रः)
A small black and venomous snake.
E.
हालाहल poison, and धर having.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to a plough, as a ploughman, cattle, &c.
E.
हल a plough, ठञ् or ठक् aff.

f. (-नी)
A sort of lizard.

m. (-लुः)
A tooth.
E.
हल to plough, उण् Uṇādi aff.
